notes: Inspected all ten current portable frames: four sides, north entrance, fluted shaft, arched watch room, octagonal signalling floors and full silhouette. The measured tapered pedestal and curved transitions remain coherent without visible open joints or detached elements.

fidelityReview.notes: Approved as the completed detailed exterior reconstruction from the published restoration survey: tapered square pedestal, narrow arched portal and round transom, continuous twelve-fluted shaft, compound capital, twelve-window guard room, three decreasing octagonal signalling floors, stone balustrades and flagpole.
